row.notes: mov rax,[rax] (3 bytes) in Team_Build_RecognitionTeamIcon (+0x81a), after the call to Game_CareerEventTable_CollectMatchingRecords at 0x1420bbb23 (rcx = pointer vector at [rsp+0xf0]); rax = [rsp+0xf8] = the vector's begin (loaded at 0x1420bbb3e), read as the first collected record whose +0x50 driver ref is the second argument of 0x1416e17b0 (the notification item's names and team icon, format '#overrides.driver_career_rewards.recognition.team_icons.%s'). Begin is 0 when no record of the career event table matches the player's entrant record, which faults reading 0x0 (crash reports at F1_25.exe+0x20bbb4a from Vm_Dispatch_BindingMessage+0x20b in a Progressive Career with a third-party calendar package, the same sessions in which site_Game_CareerEventsSequencerFirstRecord collects nothing). Core hooks it and, for rax == 0, sets rip to site_Team_RecognitionRecordsExit. A 5-byte jump covers this instruction and mov edx,[rax+0x50] (0x1420bbb4d, 3 bytes); neither is rip-relative. No branch lands at 0x1420bbb4b..0x1420bbb4f (linear sweep of 0x1420bb330..0x1420bc6d2, its jump table at 0x145770340, and a rel8/rel32 scan of 0x1420a0000..0x1420d0000).

verify.notes: V10539 Bytes 48 8B 00 = mov rax,[rax] at 0x1420bbb4a, on an instruction boundary of the linear disasm from the function start; next is 8B 50 50 mov edx,[rax+0x50] at 0x1420bbb4d, then lea rax,[rip+..] at 0x1420bbb50; neither of the two is rip-relative, so 5 bytes cover exactly both. rax comes from mov rax,[rsp+0xf8] at 0x1420bbb3e; between call 0x1424ceb70 (0x1420bbb23) and 0x1420bbb4a there is only a test on [rsi+0x6b8] feeding a cmovne of rcx, no test of rax or the vector, and the callee stores begin=0 for an empty result, so empty collection reads address 0 here. No direct jmp/jcc/call in the function targets 0x1420bbb4b..4f; the only indirect jmp is 0x1420bc49b, table at 0x145770340 has 4 entries 0x1420bc49d/4a3/4a9/4af; raw rel8/rel32/jcc32 scan of 0x1420a0000..0x1420d0000 gives zero hits into the window; no absolute pointer to 0x1420bbb4a..4f in the image (pe_index.abs_refs).
